q1.explanationZh: case 名词“事例；情况”，in most cases“在大多数情况下”。

q2.explanationZh: cash 名词“现金”，也可作动词“把（支票）兑现”。

q3.explanationZh: cash“现金”加 -ier 表示人，cashier“出纳员”，重音在第二音节。

q4.explanationZh: cast 动词“扔；投”，过去式和过去分词都是 cast；作名词还可表示“演员表”。

q5.explanationZh: castle“城堡”，字母 t 不发音。

q6.explanationZh: casual 形容词“随便的；漫不经心的”，副词是 casually。

q8.explanationZh: catalogue 是英式拼写，catalog 是美式拼写，名词“目录”，动词“编目录”。

q9.explanationZh: catch“捉住；赶上”，过去式和过去分词是 caught。

q10.explanationZh: category 名词“类别”，fall into this category“属于这一类”。

q11.explanationZh: cattle 是集合名词，只作复数用，“牛（群）”，如 ten head of cattle。

q12.explanationZh: cause 动词“导致”，名词“原因”，the cause of ...“……的起因”。

q13.explanationZh: caution 名词“谨慎”，动词“警告”，形容词是 cautious。

q14.explanationZh: cave 名词“山洞”，cave in“塌陷”。

q15.explanationZh: CD 是 compact disc 的缩写，“光盘”，要大写。

q16.explanationZh: CE 是 Common Era 的缩写，“公元”，与 AD 同义，要大写。

q17.explanationZh: cease 动词、名词同形，“停止”，cease to exist“不复存在”。

q18.explanationZh: ceiling“天花板”，注意 c 后面是 ei。

q19.explanationZh: celebrate 及物动词“庆祝”，名词是 celebration。

q20.explanationZh: celebrity 名词“名人”，复数 celebrities。

q23.explanationZh: cement 名词“水泥”，重音在第二音节。

q24.explanationZh: cemetery“墓地”，注意三个 e 的拼写。

q25.explanationZh: cent“分”，100 cents 等于 1 美元。

q26.explanationZh: centi- 表示“百分之一”，centigrade“摄氏的”。

q27.explanationZh: centimetre 是英式拼写，centimeter 是美式拼写，“厘米”。

q28.explanationZh: centre 的形容词形式 central“中心的；主要的”。

q29.explanationZh: centre 是英式拼写，center 是美式拼写，“中心”。

q31.explanationZh: ceremony“典礼”，the opening ceremony“开幕典礼”。

q32.explanationZh: certain 作表语表示“确定的”，作定语表示“某一”。

q33.explanationZh: certain 加 -ly 构成副词 certainly“无疑地；当然”。

q34.explanationZh: certificate 名词“证书”，作动词“用证书证明”，名词和动词读音不同。

q35.explanationZh: chain 名词“链条；连锁店”，动词“用链条拴住”。

q37.explanationZh: in case 后接从句，“以防万一”。

q38.explanationZh: in case of 后接名词，“假使，如果发生”。

q39.explanationZh: in no case“决不”，放在句首时句子要部分倒装。

q40.explanationZh: in the case of“至于……；就……来说”，注意有 the。

q41.explanationZh: in this/that case“若是这样/那样的话”。

q42.explanationZh: catch one’s eye“引起某人注意”。

q44.explanationZh: catch sight of“看见”，lose sight of“看不见”。

q45.explanationZh: catch (a) cold“感冒”，a 可以省略。

q47.explanationZh: catch 在这里是“听懂，理解”，catch one’s meaning“懂某人的意思”。

q48.explanationZh: catch sb. by the arm“抓住某人的手臂”，身体部位前用 the。

q50.explanationZh: certain 作定语表示“某一”，for a certain reason“为了某种理由”。

q51.explanationZh: “他现在拥有 970 家连锁食品店”，a chain of ...“一系列……；连锁”。

q52.explanationZh: 180 厘米，数字大于一，用复数 centimetres。

q53.explanationZh: 修饰名词 manner 用形容词，casual“漫不经心的”。

q54.explanationZh: cash 作动词“把（支票）兑现”，can 后接动词原形。

q55.explanationZh: were 后接现在分词构成过去进行时，catalog(ue)“编目录”，cataloging / cataloguing。

q57.explanationZh: certificate 作动词常用被动语态，is certificated“有证明”。

q58.explanationZh: catch up with“赶上”，could 后接动词原形。

q59.explanationZh: without cease“不停地”，cease 在此作名词。

q60.explanationZh: “细胞的染色体”，用名词所有格 cell’s。

q61.sampleAnswer: The TV series revolves around a certain virtual southern Chinese city, where the car industry has always been the pride.
references: The TV series revolves around a certain virtual southern Chinese city, where the car industry has always been the pride.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q61.explanationZh: “某一”= a certain，作定语；“围绕……展开”= revolve around；where 引导非限制性定语从句。

q62.sampleAnswer: She caught sight of a figure disappearing into the darkness.
references: She caught sight of a figure disappearing into the darkness.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q62.explanationZh: “看见”= catch sight of，过去时用 caught；“一个人影儿消失”用 a figure disappearing。

q63.sampleAnswer: Do you think it necessary for us middle school students to pay so much attention to internet celebrities?
references: Do you think it necessary for us middle school students to pay so much attention to internet celebrities?

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q63.explanationZh: “网红”= internet celebrities；think it necessary for sb. to do sth. 中 it 作形式宾语。

q64.sampleAnswer: One should learn some skills to survive in case something unexpected occurs.
references: One should learn some skills to survive in case something unexpected occurs.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q64.explanationZh: in case 后接从句，“以防万一”；“意外发生”= something unexpected occurs。

q65.sampleAnswer: It’s known to all that smoking can cause many diseases.
references: It’s known to all that smoking can cause many diseases.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q65.explanationZh: “众所周知”= It’s known to all that ...；“导致”= cause。

q66.sampleAnswer: As she passed the shop, a blue dress displayed in the window caught her eye.
references: As she passed the shop, a blue dress displayed in the window caught her eye.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q66.explanationZh: “吸引某人的目光”= catch one’s eye，过去时 caught her eye；displayed in the window 作后置定语。

q67.sampleAnswer: It is estimated that Shanghai will catch up with metropolises like New York and London in many ways in twenty years.
references: It is estimated that Shanghai will catch up with metropolises like New York and London in many ways in twenty years.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q67.explanationZh: “据估计”= It is estimated that ...；“赶上”= catch up with；“二十年后”用 in twenty years，配将来时。

q68.sampleAnswer: Many people love to record some touching moments which impress them with their cellphones.
references: Many people love to record some touching moments which impress them with their cellphones.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q68.explanationZh: “用手机”= with their cellphones；which 引导定语从句修饰 moments。

q69.sampleAnswer: If you have something to celebrate, something to be proud of and something to look back on when you retire, then your life will be of great value.
references: If you have something to celebrate, something to be proud of and something to look back on when you retire, then your life will be of great value.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q69.explanationZh: “值得庆祝的东西”= something to celebrate，不定式作后置定语；“很有价值”= be of great value。

q70.sampleAnswer: All the stars present at the opening ceremony were willing to donate money to the newly-established charity organization to help children who had dropped out of school.
references: All the stars present at the opening ceremony were willing to donate money to the newly-established charity organization to help children who had dropped out of school.

keyPoints.descZh: 意思完整准确
语法、拼写正确，并使用了指定词

q70.explanationZh: “开幕典礼”= the opening ceremony；present at ... 作后置定语表示“出席……的”；“失学”= drop out of school。
